Traveling Player

You have been cheered, chased away, badly paid and invited back under a different name.

Which audience surprised you?

Rules

Choose one:

- Influence 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.e99d5e7250b96ab3.JournalEntryPage.ac5e751c3183c971]{A Verse for Courage}. - Mind 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.cc75e6711f2e0bde.JournalEntryPage.ecc8ce2df009d9ff]{A Door That Is Not There}.

Type: Background

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +7 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
